# #204 Stall alert ## Parent
#201
## What to build
A coach gets one **stall alert** when a player stalls. It is a new coach alert kind modelled as a signal episode (ADR 032). It opens when stall length reaches 8 (one named constant) and the player has no missed-day streak, and a best-effort in-app coach notice goes out that carries no training detail. While the alert is open, further stalled sessions update its recorded session count on the same alert. The system resolves it on a personal record, a newly published program version, or the start of a missed-day streak. Coaches acknowledge or resolve it like any other alert. Android and web alert centres show the kind with its own label.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At the 8th committing session without a personal record, with no missed-day streak, exactly one new stall alert opens and one coach notice is sent (API test through the player commit route and the coach alert centre). - [ ] Further stalled sessions update the same alert's session count and never create a second alert. - [ ] A personal record, a new program version, or a missed-day streak system-resolves the open stall alert. - [ ] No stall alert opens while a missed-day streak is running. - [ ] Re-processing or re-syncing a session is a no-op for the alert. - [ ] Alert evidence holds only stall length and the window start date, with no set detail and no identity. - [ ] Acknowledge and resolve work through the existing coach alert routes, and acknowledged or resolved stall alerts stay out of the urgency counts. - [ ] Android and web alert centres label the kind, with widget tests. - [ ] During the trial every coach receives it. Coach Pro gating is #55's job (see the comment there).
